snippet.title: Guns 'n Goblins - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Guns 'n Goblins, a horde-based survival first-person shooter developed by Soulgame and Lance. Players will take on waves of enemies to defend the coveted castle from being destroyed. Level up, attain upgrades, and take down dragons in Guns 'n Goblins, coming soon to PC (Steam).

#GunsNGoblins #Gaming #IGN
